english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for depression as a mental illness and is also commonly used for a depressive episode.

examples.english: I think I have depression and have been seeing a doctor for several months.
examples.traditional: 我覺得自己有抑鬱症，已經睇咗幾個月醫生。
